chunks: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abd al-Karim ibn Amr, from Abi Basir, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
"A girl is not entered into (consummated) until she reaches nine years or ten years."

key_terms.يُدْخَلُ: Is entered into (referring to consummation of marriage)

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum age for consummating marriage for a girl in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifies the age range of nine to ten years as the threshold for a female child's readiness for marital consummation, reflecting the juristic consensus in Shia fiqh regarding 'bulugh' (puberty) in this context. It is frequently cited alongside the hadith of 'al-khams' (one-fifth of the bride price) to determine the financial rights of the minor, highlighting the distinction between the contract of marriage and the actual consummation.
